title: Icy PvP Pack
description: Icy textures for Cart PvP and Crystal PvP
body: A clean ice-themed PvP pack designed for both Cart PvP and Crystal PvP. This pack features frosty blue textures, smaller item models for improved visibility, and a transparent GUI that keeps your screen clear during fights. Built for competitive gameplay, it combines a sleek frozen aesthetic with practical optimizations to help you stay focused and perform at your best in every battle.
